semanticRules.ownedTransfer: rt take consumes sender authority and requires Send
semanticRules.readonlyView: view is not allocation freeze; no implicit Sync or Share
semanticRules.immutableSharing: requires compiler-proven immutable backing and transitive element safety
semanticRules.sharedMutable: requires explicit synchronized/atomic handle or actor message serialization
semanticRules.protectedBorrow: critical-read and critical-write loans/views/iterators may not escape their guard
semanticRules.suspension: no suspension with live guard until separately proved safe
semanticRules.taskRead: both canonical Sync and independent thread/lifetime proof required
semanticRules.atomicity: multiple individually synchronized calls are not automatically one transaction

scenarios.requirement: Ordinary mutable collection is exclusive to one actor; no implicit lock
A Send collection moves to the recipient, preserving single ownership
Sender uses transferred collection after rt take
Readonly view alone cannot mint Sync or Share if writable aliases remain
Option/Result/Arc/Weak cannot mint missing Sync or Share
Borrowed collection cannot escape into independent Task
SharedMutex must consume owned payload rather than a borrow
Original collection cannot be used after SharedMutex takes ownership
Protected guard cannot remain live across await or scheduler suspension
Lock guard iterator/view/borrow cannot outlive protected scope
General Sync classification without independently verified thread/lifetime proof cannot mint READ authority
Verified immutable inline tuple preserves safe scoped READ path
Concurrent increments under one guard have exact count and no lost update
Explicit concurrent table has one linearizable winner, pending API finalization
Compare exchange is linearizable with no torn writes, pending API finalization
Sealed actor state coordinates concurrent readers and exclusive writers
